sets.name: Melee Physical
sets.description: Standard melee DPS: damage scaling first, then attack frequency.
sets.notes: Off-Hand Attack Bonus matters only for Two Weapon Fighting; remove it otherwise.

sets.name: Melee (Weapon-Focused)
sets.description: Melee Physical plus weapon base damage and crit profile as explicit priorities.
sets.notes: Weapon-property stats only affect Weapon1 — see docs/PHASE10_PLAN.md §15.4.

sets.name: Unarmed / Monk
sets.notes: Set Weapon Style to a centered option; this set does not change weapon filtering.

sets.name: Spell Caster (Fire / Evocation)
sets.description: Single-element caster template. Swap the element and school to match your build.
sets.notes: Replace 'fire' with your element and 'evocation' with your school. Fire Caster Level is undocumented in the data files and may match nothing.

sets.name: Warlock (Eldritch Blast)
sets.description: Pact dice scaling. Deliberately omits Spell DC and elemental spellpower.
sets.notes: Do not add traditional Spell DC. Spellpower is Tier 5 here because it only affects personal buff spells.

sets.name: Mixed (Attack + Spell)
sets.description: Dual-purpose build leaning on procs that trigger from both attacks and spells.
sets.notes: Pick your dominant damage source for Tier 1; the other side sits at Tier 2-3.
